regime_context: The detector marks a broad, non-one-narrative Canadian market with Gold Miners as the clearest leader (rank 1, durability 0.73, full breadth, not crowded) and Silver & Royalties as a very close challenger (0.147 margin), while energy and financials hold mid-table consolidation. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdown on this market, so trend health is a legitimate sizing lens; however, the 66-call track record shows only 33% directional accuracy, so convictions must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver & Royalties confirms a handoff from Gold Miners: the margin is only 0.147 and silver's durability (0.67) is close to gold's (0.73), but its hurst_tag is mean-revert — the watch retires if XGD.TO and the silver proxy diverge by more than 3% relative over ten sessions with silver's breadth staying at 1.0.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners hold the strongest composite: highest score, best durability (0.73), full breadth (1.0), not crowded (z 0.65). The absolute-trend gate is active and historically helped this market avoid drawdown, so the trend-health leg supports holding the leader rather than chasing it. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not a forecast, so the lean is continuity-of-leadership, not a return call.
evidence: rank 1, score 2.145, eligible=true via absolute-trend gate
theses.dissent: Precious metals leadership in Canada is often a risk-off/flight-to-safety response, and XGD.TO's trailing 10-day return (r10 -6.6%) shows the theme has already mean-reverted hard recently; a bounce may already be priced.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers are eligible and rank third, but they carry the only crowded flag among the leaders (crowding_z 1.2, crowded=true) with less-than-full breadth (0.714). Crowding is a size-down caution only, not a short call, but combined with a trend tag of 'mixed' there is no positive edge to lean into; avoiding the theme avoids the crowding reflexivity risk.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z 1.2 (highest in the eligible set)
theses.dissent: Higher energy prices and positive macro energy headlines (seen in the macro backdrop) could reignite momentum, and a crowded theme can stay crowded longer than expected.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a new 60-day high with breadth above 0.85 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper rank fourth and are eligible, but their durability (0.57) is thinner than the precious metals leaders and the trend tag is 'mean-revert'. The rotation read shows a broad, non-directional market with no confirmed handoff into base metals, so there is no trend-following leg to support an overweight.
theses.dissent: Industrial demand or a commodity supercycle narrative could catch and reverse the mean-revert tag, but that is a next-narrative call this detector is explicitly not equipped to make.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO crosses above XGD.TO on a 20-day relative-strength basis before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
